displayAddress: The Chare, Newcastle upon Tyne, NE1
description:
**TENANTED PROPERTY**

Offered for sale strictly as an investment-only opportunity, this well-presented apartment is currently tenanted and provides an attractive opportunity for landlords and investors seeking an established rental income.

The property forms part of an attractive modern development and offers bright, well-proportioned accommodation throughout. The accommodation comprises a comfortable living/dining area, a fitted kitchen with a range of wall and base units, integrated cooking facilities and space for a washing machine, a well-presented bedroom and a modern bathroom with bath and shower.

The apartment is neutrally decorated throughout and benefits from excellent natural light, creating a pleasant and comfortable living environment.

Currently let to a tenant, the property offers an attractive gross rental yield of approximately 12%, making this an appealing proposition for investors seeking a strong income-producing property.
